title: Box bound for the volume of a Euclidean ball
statement: For every n ∈ ℕ and every real r ≥ 0, the closed ball closedBall(0, r) of ℝ^n (Eucl n, with the Euclidean norm) has Lebesgue measure at most (2r)^n: L(closedBall(0, r)) ≤ ofReal((2r)^n) in [0, ∞].
lean_statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (r : ℝ), 0 ≤ r → volume (closedBall (0 : Eucl n) r) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal ((2 * r) ^ n)
